what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A tour of the no-server studio: what is real, what is simulated, and the plan.
sections.para: An infographic studio built to the blueprint: one HTML file of seven web components, drawing in the browser. A deterministic extractor stands in for the model; the vault host holds any key. The flow uses invented money; the plan is for somebody to build; nine of twelve steps are done; synthetic users and a live check tested it.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: Built to the blueprint; mostly simulated on purpose; the key is never the studio's; the flow with invented money; a business plan with a calculator; nine of twelve checklist steps done; synthetic users first, and a bug found live.

sections.label: The studio
sections.line: Four samples, four layouts, three themes, drawn in the browser.
sections.para: Pick a sample or paste your own document, choose a poster, big numbers, cards or steps, and a theme. The gallery draws every sample in every layout from the same engine, which also tests every combination.

sections.label: How the content is made
sections.line: Extract, prompt, parse, render: the model only writes the words.
sections.para: The simulation finds the title, the numbers with what they count, the points and the steps. The model's path sends the document and asks for the same shape as JSON. Either way the browser draws the SVG, so the simulation is a fair stand-in.

sections.label: Where the model's key comes from
sections.line: Three sources for the model's key, and the studio shows which.
sections.para: Inside the vault, the host holds the key, caps the spend and asks first; on a public read it answers ENOKEY. Served as its own page, OpenRouter OAuth or a pasted key held in memory, written but not yet run live. Otherwise, simulation.

sections.label: The flow, with invented money
sections.line: The blueprint's eight steps, with invented money.
sections.para: A simulated passkey, an OAuth round trip, £10 bought at the provider, a £2 cap, a penny per generation, results kept with the user, and the gap: £2 the studio would earn at a fifth, which no provider pays today.

sections.label: The business plan
sections.line: Three businesses, five packages, ninety days and a calculator.
sections.para: The studio, a studio that builds these for others, and the credit layer. At its starting hypotheses the calculator gives about £4,250 a month, or £4,364 with a provider share. Users pay the model's cost at the provider. Every number is a hypothesis.

sections.label: The checklist
sections.line: Nine done, two partial, one simulated.
sections.para: Done: no backend, components, vendoring, offline, anywhere, storage, simulation, synthetic users, pricing. Partial: no dev and main branches yet, and the own-key path not yet live. Simulated: the passkey, since the vault's sandboxed frame cannot use WebAuthn.

sections.label: Synthetic users, and the bug they did not find
sections.line: Three personas passed; a live check found what they could not.
sections.para: Maya on a phone, Tom pasting his own text and Ana deciding whether to build it all passed their checks. The live check in the vault UI found that its sandbox has no session storage, which broke the OAuth return code; it is guarded now.

sections.label: How it is built
sections.line: Seven component files, inlined into one page by a script.
sections.para: Components live as separate files and tools/bundle.py inlines them with the engine and data, since a vault app is one page. assemble.py writes the gallery, plan and checklist; synthetic_users.mjs runs the personas. The same page runs from the vault, a file or any host.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Simulated, unproven live, a simulated passkey, an extractor, no share today.
sections.para: Documents, money and plan numbers are invented or hypotheses. The live-key path has not run against a real key. The passkey is simulated. The extractor picks words rather than writing them. No provider pays apps a share today.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The blueprint, the vault platform's guide, and the vault.
sections.para: The no-server startup for the blueprint; the vault platform's authoring guide, read 20 October 2026, for the host's model interface; and the no-server studio vault for every number, with links to the Pellbridge tour and free models with your own key.
